description: Returns one published week of the free UK or Australian online shelf-price index (CC BY 4.0): index levels, week-on-week change and matched-product counts by retailer and product class. Use it for "how did posted grocery shelf prices move this week". Not a CPI, not prices paid, no product names. Omit vintage for the latest week; call list_index_vintages for the others.

class.description: Only rows for this product class id, e.g. "dairy-eggs".

recordType.description: Only rows of this kind, e.g. "headline". Omit for all rows.

retailer.description: Only rows for this retailer id, e.g. "tesco" (UK) or "aldi_au" (AU).

vintage.description: ISO week, e.g. "2026-W42". Omit for the latest published week.

name: get_shelf_price_index
title: Shelf-price index for one week
